description: WORKER: add a PlayHQ Discovery GraphQL season resolver and two routes to playhq-worker/src/index.ts. (1) fetchSeasonGrades(seasonId, env) POSTs the gradeListDiscoverSeason query with the same browser-like headers as fetchPlayerCareer and returns a cleaned season/competition/organisation/grades shape. (2) GET /api/competition/:seasonId/grades: read-only, public, short edge cache. (3) GET/POST /api/admin/sweep-competition: token-gated (reuse BACKFILL_TOKEN gate EXACTLY), batched + resumable, resolves the season's grades then processes ONE small slice of the grade at gradeIndex by reusing runBackfillBatch UNCHANGED, returning a resumable cursor. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 consumes these endpoints; must land first. Verified in planning: the trimmed query returns HTTP 200 / 10 grades incl ce56b707 for season ce93ea21.
steps: Read playhq-worker/src/index.ts FIRST. Study: the CAREER_QUERY embedded-constant style and fetchPlayerCareer (exact browser headers); the UpstreamError class; the json() helper; corsHeaders + the `cors` var and `url`/`ctx` in the fetch() handler; the caches.default usage in /api/player/:id/profile; the /api/admin/backfill-players token gate; and runBackfillBatch (its BackfillBatchResult shape: grade,totalGames,offset,limit,processed,skipped,nextOffset,done). ID_RE validates short ids; UUID_RE validates full UUIDs.

Add a module const GRADE_LIST_QUERY embedding VERBATIM the trimmed query: `query gradeListDiscoverSeason($id: String!) { discoverSeason(seasonID: $id) { id name competition { id name type organisation { id type name __typename } __typename } status { name value __typename } grades { id name day { name value __typename } gender { name value __typename } age { name value __typename } __typename } __typename } }`.

Add async function fetchSeasonGrades(seasonId, env): POST to PLAYHQ_GRAPH with headers { 'Content-Type':'application/json', Accept:'*/*', 'User-Agent':BROWSER_UA, 'Accept-Language':'en-US,en;q=0.9', Origin:'https://www.playhq.com', Referer:'https://www.playhq.com/', tenant: (env.PHQ_TENANT ?? 'afl') } and body { operationName:'gradeListDiscoverSeason', variables:{ id: seasonId }, query: GRADE_LIST_QUERY }, with AbortSignal.timeout(12_000). Map 429->UpstreamError('rate_limited',429), 403->('forbidden',403), !ok->('upstream_error',502), data.errors?.length->('graphql_errors',502), missing data.discoverSeason->('not_found',404). Return a null-safe cleaned object: { season:{id,name,status: status?.value ?? status?.name ?? null}, competition:{id,name,type}, organisation:{id,name,type} from competition.organisation, grades: (discoverSeason.grades ?? []).map(g => ({ id:g.id, name:g.name, gender:g.gender?.value ?? null, age:g.age?.value ?? null, day:g.day?.value ?? null })) }. Guard every nested object/array against null.

Add route GET /api/competition/:seasonId/grades among the GET cache routes (AFTER the `if (request.method !== 'GET')` guard), matching with url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/competition\/([^/]+)\/grades$/). Validate the seasonId with the EXISTING ID_RE (NOT UUID_RE). Mirror /api/player/:id/profile: check caches.default with key new Request(`https://playhq-cache/competition-grades/${seasonId}/${tenant}`) where tenant = url.searchParams.get('tenant') || env.PHQ_TENANT || 'afl'; on HIT return cached text with X-Cache:HIT; on MISS call fetchSeasonGrades, JSON.stringify, cache with Cache-Control max-age ~120 via ctx.waitUntil(cache.put(...)), return with X-Cache:MISS and ...cors. Map UpstreamError to its status (Retry-After 120 on 429) like sibling routes. No token.

Add route GET/POST /api/admin/sweep-competition BEFORE the `if (request.method !== 'GET')` guard (right after the /api/admin/backfill-players block) so POST reaches it. Copy the token gate VERBATIM from backfill-players (Bearer header via Authorization minus /^Bearer\s+/i, OR x-backfill-token header, OR ?token=; 401 json when !env.BACKFILL_TOKEN || provided !== env.BACKFILL_TOKEN). Read params: season (validate with ID_RE -> 400 invalid_season on fail), gradeIndex (Number, default 0, floor, >=0), offset (default 0, floor, >=0), limit (default 10, Math.min(12, floor) when positive — identical to backfill).

Sweep logic: in try/catch -> const resolved = await fetchSeasonGrades(season, env); const grades = resolved.grades; if (grades.length === 0) return done:true empty cursor; clamp gradeIndex; if (gradeIndex >= grades.length) return done:true (next:null); const gradeId = grades[gradeIndex].id; const batch = await runBackfillBatch(gradeId, offset, limit, env) (REUSE UNCHANGED — it try/catches each game into `skipped`, paces between games, returns totalGames/processed/skipped/nextOffset/done). Pass gradeId in the SHORT form GraphQL returned (see the grade-id OPEN DECISION in the plan: first rely on the short id; only add a UUID-resolution shim if a live REST check shows the short id is rejected — record the outcome in findings). Compute next cursor: if (batch.nextOffset != null) next = { gradeIndex, offset: batch.nextOffset }, done=false; else { const ng = gradeIndex+1; done = ng >= grades.length; next = done ? null : { gradeIndex: ng, offset: 0 } }.

Return the resumable cursor JSON via json(...,200,cors): { season:{id,name}, competition, organisation, grades (full list of {id,name,gender,age}), gradeIndex, gradeId, gradeName: grades[gradeIndex].name, totalGames: batch.totalGames, offset, limit, processed: batch.processed, skipped: batch.skipped, done, next }. On UpstreamError map to its status (Retry-After 120 on 429) like backfill; on other errors json({error:'sweep_failed'},502,cors).
Typecheck: cd playhq-worker && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json — fix any errors.

If a real PHQ_API_KEY and BACKFILL_TOKEN are available in the environment, do a best-effort live slice via `wrangler dev` against season ce93ea21 (gradeIndex=3, offset=0, limit=2) and confirm processed>0 + a sane next cursor; record whether fetchGradeGames accepted the SHORT grade id (ce56b707) or needed the full UUID in findings. If secrets are unavailable, state that and rely on the typecheck + the planning-confirmed GraphQL 200.
acceptance_criteria: GRADE_LIST_QUERY is embedded verbatim (trimmed form) and fetchSeasonGrades returns the cleaned { season, competition, organisation, grades[] } shape, throwing UpstreamError on non-200/GraphQL errors/missing discoverSeason.
GET /api/competition/:seasonId/grades is read-only (no token), validates seasonId with ID_RE, is edge-cached, and returns cleaned JSON.

GET/POST /api/admin/sweep-competition uses the EXACT backfill token gate, validates season with ID_RE, processes exactly one grade slice via runBackfillBatch (limit hard-capped at 12), and returns the resumable cursor with the full grades list, gradeIndex, counts, done, and the next {gradeIndex,offset} (advancing offset within a grade, then to the next grade, then done).
runBackfillBatch, fetchGradeGames, fetchGameSummary, ingestPlayers are reused UNCHANGED (no duplication, no schema change).
cd playhq-worker && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json passes with no errors.
verification: cd c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\.worktrees\comp-sweep\playhq-worker && npm install && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json  (must be clean)

Live GraphQL 200 check against season ce93ea21 returns 10 grades incl ce56b707 'Division One Senior Men' (confirmed in planning; re-run the POST to api.playhq.com/graphql with header tenant:afl if desired).

Best-effort (only if PHQ_API_KEY + BACKFILL_TOKEN present): wrangler dev then GET /api/admin/sweep-competition?season=ce93ea21&gradeIndex=3&offset=0&limit=2&token=... returns processed>0 and a sane next cursor.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED in playhq-worker/src/index.ts (single-file worker). Added: (1) const GRADE_LIST_QUERY (verbatim trimmed gradeListDiscoverSeason doc) + types SeasonGrade/SeasonGrades + async fetchSeasonGrades(seasonId, env) — placed right after UUID_RE; it POSTs to PLAYHQ_GRAPH with the exact fetchPlayerCareer browser header set (incl lowercase tenant = env.PHQ_TENANT ?? 'afl'), AbortSignal.timeout(12_000), maps 429->rate_limited(429)/403->forbidden(403)/!ok->upstream_error(502)/errors->graphql_errors(502)/missing discoverSeason->not_found(404), and returns a fully null-safe { season:{id,name,status}, competition:{id,name,type}, organisation:{id,name,type}, grades:[{id,name,gender,age,day}] } (enum {value||name} flattened to string, null grades -> []). (2) Public read-only route GET /api/competition/:seasonId/grades — placed just before the /api/player/:id/profile (careerMatch) route, AFTER the request.method!=='GET' guard; validates seasonId with ID_RE (NOT UUID_RE), edge-caches via caches.default key https://playhq-cache/competition-grades/{seasonId}/{tenant} with max-age 120 + X-Cache HIT/MISS + ctx.waitUntil(cache.put), UpstreamError->status (Retry-After 120 on 429), no token. (3) Token-gated resumable route GET/POST /api/admin/sweep-competition — placed right after the /api/admin/backfill-players block, BEFORE the GET-only guard so POST reaches it; token gate copied VERBATIM from backfill-players (Bearer / x-backfill-token / ?token=; 401 when !env.BACKFILL_TOKEN || mismatch); params season (ID_RE -> 400 invalid_season), gradeIndex (default 0, floor, >=0), offset (default 0, floor, >=0), limit (default 10, Math.min(12,floor) when positive); resolves grades via fetchSeasonGrades, handles grades.length===0 and gradeIndex>=length as done:true/next:null, else processes ONE slice via runBackfillBatch(gradeId, offset, limit, env) UNCHANGED and computes next = {gradeIndex, offset: batch.nextOffset} while the grade has more games, else {gradeIndex: ng, offset:0} (done when ng>=length). Returns the exact cursor JSON { season:{id,name}, competition, organisation, grades (full list), gradeIndex, gradeId, gradeName, totalGames, offset, limit, processed, skipped, done, next }; UpstreamError->status (Retry-After 120 on 429), other errors -> {error:'sweep_failed'} 502. runBackfillBatch/fetchGradeGames/fetchGameSummary/ingestPlayers reused UNCHANGED; no schema change; no new env vars.

VERIFICATION: npm install (106 pkgs) then `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` is CLEAN (exit 0). Live GraphQL re-run against season ce93ea21 returned HTTP 200 / 10 grades incl ce56b707 'Peninsula Private Hospital - MPFNL Division One Senior Men'; comp 'Mornington Peninsula Football Netball League', org 'MPFNL', season '2026'. All 10 grade ids are SHORT ids (e.g. 25b62192, ce56b707, 403c1ad9, ...).

GRADE-ID OPEN DECISION — OUTCOME: No PHQ_API_KEY and no BACKFILL_TOKEN are present in this environment (verified: both absent; no .dev.vars/.env in playhq-worker), so the REST-backed sweep slice (wrangler dev against the live REST API) could NOT be run — exactly as context.json predicted. Per the plan's decision, the SHORT grade id (as GraphQL returns it, e.g. ce56b707) is passed straight through to runBackfillBatch -> fetchGradeGames(`${PLAYHQ_REST}/grades/${gradeId}/games`) with NO resolution shim added. The short-id-vs-UUID question for the REST grades endpoint therefore remains UNVERIFIED LIVE. ACTION FOR FEAT-002 / integration: when a real PHQ_API_KEY + BACKFILL_TOKEN are available, run `wrangler dev` then GET /api/admin/sweep-competition?season=ce93ea21&gradeIndex=3&offset=0&limit=2&token=... and confirm processed>0 (gradeIndex 3 = ce56b707 Division One Senior Men). If fetchGradeGames 404s/rejects the short id, a UUID-resolution shim must be added inside fetchSeasonGrades or the sweep route (the short id would then need mapping to a full grade UUID); if it returns games, no change is needed. Re-running any slice is upsert-safe (ingestPlayers upserts playhq_players + playhq_player_appearances).

ENDPOINT CONTRACT FOR FEAT-002 (final paths + params): (a) GET {WORKER_BASE}/api/competition/{seasonId}/grades (public, no token; optional ?tenant=; returns SeasonGrades shape above). (b) GET|POST {WORKER_BASE}/api/admin/sweep-competition?season={id}&gradeIndex={n}&offset={n}&limit={<=12}&token={BACKFILL_TOKEN} (token also accepted via Authorization: Bearer or x-backfill-token header). Drive the loop from {gradeIndex:0,offset:0}, follow the returned `next` cursor each call, stop when done:true (next:null). Season id must match ID_RE /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{4,64}$/ (short id, NOT a UUID).
